name: github
title: GitHub
description: GitHub connector for repositories, issues, pull requests, reviews, releases and Actions. Backed by a GitHub App.
agent_instruction:
Use GitHub to manage repositories, issues, pull requests, reviews, releases, and GitHub Actions. Read and write repo content, triage issues with labels, assignees and milestones, review pull requests, and read code scanning, Dependabot and secret scanning alerts.
For Actions: list and inspect workflow runs and their jobs, download run or job logs and artifacts, dispatch a workflow, and cancel or re-run one. Secrets and variables can be listed but not changed.
To write several files as one commit, use the git data operations (git_create_blob, git_create_tree, git_create_commit, git_update_ref) rather than one repos_create_or_update_file_contents per file; git_get_ref, git_update_ref, git_delete_ref and git_list_matching_refs take a whole ref path such as heads/main.
Projects v2 exists only in GitHub's GraphQL API -- use github_graphql_request for it. For any other REST endpoint the curated operations do not cover, use github_http_request.

CVE Exploit Prediction Scoring System (EPSS) percentage. Can be specified as:
- An exact number (`n`)
- Comparators such as `>n`, `<n`, `>=n`, `<=n`
- A range like `n..n`, where `n` is a number from 0.0 to 1.0

Filters the list of alerts based on EPSS percentages. If specified, only alerts with the provided EPSS percentages will be returned.

has.description:
Filters the list of alerts based on whether the alert has the given value. If specified, only alerts meeting this criterion will be returned.
Multiple `has` filters can be passed to filter for alerts that have all of the values. Currently, only `patch` is supported.

assignee.description:
Filter alerts by assignees.
Provide a comma-separated list of user handles (e.g., `octocat` or `octocat,hubot`) to return alerts assigned to any of the specified users.
Use `*` to list alerts with at least one assignee or `none` to list alerts with no assignees.

scope.description: The scope of the vulnerable dependency. If specified, only alerts with this scope will be returned.

relationship.description:
A comma-separated list of relationships of the vulnerable dependency to your project. If specified, only alerts with these relationships will be returned.

> [!NOTE]
> We are rolling out support for dependency relationship across ecosystems. This value will be "unknown" for all dependencies in unsupported ecosystems.

returned.
